scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-darkcloud "npm run test -w functions"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p functions && tsc -p web
scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-darkcloud --ui "npm run dev -w web"
